    Your shift: 6:00–6:30 PM

    You are the operations manager of a high-demand dark store at peak hour. Keep customers happy while balancing speed, inventory and operating cost.

    1Watch

    Orders flow from new to delivered in the 3D store and the pipeline below it. Red pins and cards are at risk.

    2Decide

    Call gig riders, add pickers, bundle trips, tighten the radius, replenish shelves. Every lever costs something.

    3Use the AI

    The copilot explains each recommendation: benefit, downside and confidence. Accept or dismiss. You decide.

    Big moments pause the clock so you can decide. Space pauses any time.

    How to play

    In one line: deliver orders within 15 minutes without overspending. Watch the Right now line on the left: it tells you what is going wrong. The AI copilot on the right suggests a fix; press Accept or Dismiss, or use the Actions buttons yourself.

    You run dark store LJP-07 for the 30-minute evening peak: about 4.5 real minutes on Beginner, 3 minutes on Standard (2× speed halves it). Orders arrive continuously from six neighbourhoods.

    Every order moves through eight stages

    New → Confirmed (stock reserved) → Picking → Packing → Packed → Rider assigned → Out for delivery → Delivered. Watch it in the 3D store and in the pipeline strip. The promise is 15 minutes from order (10 for premium orders).

    Your levers

    On Beginner the screen shows only the essentials: extra riders, extra pickers, bundling and restocking. Press Show more controls (or switch off Simple view in ⚙ Settings) for dispatch priority, delivery radius, staff moves and the Orders and Fleet tabs.

    Riders: call up to 3 gig riders (₹50 + ₹6/min) or release them. Floor staff: move people between picking and packing for free, or add flex pickers (₹7/min). Bundling: one rider carries two same-neighbourhood orders: cheaper, but the second drop is later. Dispatch priority: first-in-first-out, most urgent first, or highest value first. Delivery radius: the 1.8 km core radius protects speed but declines outer-zone orders. Stock-outs: hold orders for stock or ship available items and refund the rest. Replenish: +6 units for ₹25, arriving in 3 minutes.

    Click any order (in the list or a pin on the map) to prioritise it, bundle it, assign a rider or handle a stock hold. Click a shelf to see stock.

    The AI copilot

    It reads the live store every few seconds and proposes actions with the reason, expected benefit, downside and confidence. Accept or dismiss. Your follow rate is reported at the end, alongside an AI autopilot that accepts every suggestion and a store left on default settings.

    Score

    A 0–100 Control Room Score balances SLA, satisfaction, completion, delivery time, cost per order, profitability, stock-outs, rider utilisation and crisis response. Over-spending to protect speed loses points, and so does saving money while customers wait.

    Keyboard

    Space pause · A accept top AI card · D dismiss top card · 1/2/3 camera · F speed
